title: Customer Service Administrator
description:
Customer Service Administrator
Location: Bournemouth
Salary: £26,000 DOE
Hours: Full-time, Monday to Friday
Working hours: 8:00am 4:30pm or 8:30am 5:00pm

Tru Talent is delighted to be working with a well-established and growing waste management company in Bournemouth, who are looking for an experienced Customer Service Administrator to join their team.

This is a varied and important role, combining customer service, administration and coordination to help ensure the smooth running of day-to-day operations.

We re looking for someone who is organised, proactive and confident communicating with customers, suppliers and internal teams. You ll be a strong team player who is also comfortable using your own initiative and taking ownership of tasks.

As a Customer Service Administrator, your responsibilities will include:
- Handling operational calls professionally and efficiently
- Building strong relationships with customers and suppliers
- Managing customer accounts and dealing with queries
- Processing orders and liaising with suppliers
- Advising customers on commercial and domestic waste services
- Supporting customer accounts and processing payments
- Managing contractor pricing and purchase orders
- Assisting with new site set-ups
- Keeping internal systems and records accurate and up to date
- Communicating important information across different teams
- Resolving customer queries and issues promptly and effectively
- Providing general administrative support to the Customer Service team
- Supporting other departments when required

To be successful in this role, you will ideally have:
- Previous experience in a customer service and administration role
- Hospitality experience will also be considered
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills
- Strong organisational skills and excellent attention to detail
- A confident and professional telephone manner
- Good IT skills, particularly Microsoft Outlook, Excel and Word
- The ability to prioritise workloads and manage multiple tasks
- A proactive approach with the ability to work independently
- Previous experience within the waste management or construction industry would be preferred, but is not essential

Click Apply Now to take the next step in your career.

title: CUSTOMER SERVICE ADVISOR
company: Talent Sure Recruitment Limited - Agency - Permanent
description:
Customer Service Advisor

Location: Bournemouth, Dorset

Salary: £25,000 per annum (increasing after probation)

Hours: Monday-Friday 8:30am 5:00pm (+ Occasional Saturday mornings)

Contract: Temporary to Permanent

About the Opportunity:

Are you looking to establish a rewarding career in a professional office environment? A fantastic opportunity has arisen for an enthusiastic and motivated Customer Service Advisor to join a highly successful, growing business based in central Bournemouth.

This role is perfect for an individual who is eager to gain valuable office experience within a supportive team. The company is renowned for its vibrant, inclusive, and positive workplace culture, offering excellent training and genuine opportunities for long-term professional development.

Key Responsibilities:

As a Customer Service Advisor, you will report directly to the Customer Service Manager and act as the first point of contact for clients and suppliers. Your day-to-day duties will include:
- Handling incoming telephone enquiries, addressing customer queries efficiently, or directing calls to the correct department.
- Listening to client requirements, providing clear support and advice, and ensuring an exceptional customer experience.
- Managing the customer service inbox, responding to emails promptly, or allocating complex queries to relevant internal teams.
- Liaising with suppliers on behalf of clients to resolve queries and ensure smooth communication.
- Updating and maintaining accurate client records, including company names and location changes.
- Monitoring and checking client deliveries, updating purchase orders accordingly.
- Sourcing emergency suppliers when required and verifying their documentation against regulatory standards.
- Escalating complex issues to the Customer Service Manager to ensure swift resolution.
- Assisting the management team with ad-hoc projects and administrative tasks.

What We Are Looking For:

While previous office experience is a bonus, it is not essential. We are looking for individuals who possess:
- Strong verbal and written communication skills with a professional telephone manner.
- Excellent organisational skills and the ability to manage tasks in a fast-paced environment.
- A positive, proactive attitude and a willingness to learn.
- The ability to work effectively as part of a close-knit team.

Benefits & Culture:

This business prides itself on creating an outstanding work environment where employees feel valued. Alongside a structured training programme, you will benefit from:
- Starting Salary: £25,000, rising after probation.
- Annual Leave: 23 days holiday, increasing by 1 day for each consecutive year of service (capped at an additional 5 days).
- Bank Holidays: No bank holiday working required.
- Healthcare: Private healthcare plan option available post-probation.
- Wellbeing: On-site gym access and complimentary chiropractor sessions upon passing probation.
- Office Environment: Modern, central office space featuring dedicated breakout areas.
- Perks: Monthly team incentives and complimentary healthy beverages and breakfast options.

If you are ready to take the next step in your career with a supportive company that offers fantastic perks and a brilliant culture, please submit your CV for consideration.

title: Customer Service Advisor
company: The Work Shop Resourcing Ltd - Agency - Temporary
description:
Location: Bournemouth

title: Payroll Administrator
description:
Payroll Administrator
Salary: Up To £29,000

Hours: Monday, Tuesday & Wednesday 8.30am till 5pm

Thursday 8.30am till 5.30pm

Friday: 8.30am till 4.30pm

Location: Bournemouth

32 Days Holiday (including Bank Holidays) - After 3 year Service an additional 1 day Holiday, 5 years an additional 1 day Holiday & 10 year service additional 2 days Holiday
Potential Hybrid/remote option
Birthday Off
Beer Fridge every Friday
Exclusive Discounts & Offers Most Major Retailers
Access to health & wellbeing services

If you are looking for a fun, happy working environment, this is for you!
Our client is an established and highly reputable payroll services company. They have been a major player for more than 20 years and have worked with thousands of people across a wide range of industries.

As a Payroll Administrator here is what you would have done last week:
Processing a weekly payroll, including managing new starters and leavers.
Statutory Payments such as holiday pay, SSP, SMP, SPP.
Dealing with Auto-enrolment Pensions.
Corresponding with HMRC as necessary
Submitting RTI reports to HMRC within required timescales.
Dealing with queries from clients, their employees, and the relevant local authorities.
Production of Bank Payments

Who you are:
You possess payroll experience from a previous employment.
You will be experienced working in a payroll environment and will be able to utilise a variety of communication channels including over the phone, email etc.
You can work under pressure.
You can demonstrate a good standard of numeracy and literacy.
You have Strong communication skills, both oral and written.
You will be resilient, self-motivated, assertive, and confident.

What s in it for you:
We ll enable you to challenge yourself. Make a positive impact on our business. Growing with us and making your mark, always learning. You ll have 32 days holiday (including Bank Holidays) so you can take some downtime whenever you need it and you ll never work on your birthday again. You ll get a pension plan that supports you for the future, and an employee discount scheme that is in a class of its own.

title: Administrator
description: Regents Park Healthcare are looking for an Administrator to work within the administration team at the Dorset Heart Clinic. The right candidate should have 2 years administration experience ideally within NHS or other healthcare settings, strong IT skills and have an outgoing and friendly attitude. The work can be highly demanding, therefore, the ability to prioritise your own workload and meet deadlines is also essential. JOB TITLE: Administrator REPORTS TO: Clinic Manager LOCATION: Dorset Heart Clinic, Bournemouth, UK HOURS: Working patterns are assigned across Monday to Sat, typically covering 8am - 8pm with full-time hours equating to 37.5 per week. We expect there will be no requirement to work Bank Holidays without prior & mutual agreement. SALARY: From £25,685.00/year, depending on experience. JOB TYPE: Full-time, Permanent BENEFITS: Company events Company pension contributions Health & wellbeing programme On-site parking Private medical insurance Generous Sick pay Life Cover 25 days holiday + bank holidays RESPONSIBILITIES AND DUTIES To liaise effectively and efficiently with (but not limited to) the following individuals/organisations: Consultants and their secretaries. Patients and their relatives. Referring GPs and their offices. Private medical insurance companies. Clinical staff. NHS Trust staff. Self-Payers; and Other third-party organisations. To manage correspondence and telephone enquiries speedily and accurately. To book outpatients appointments onto IT systems. To prepare medical notes and other clinical information in preparation for a clinical session, ensuring all paperwork is filed correctly and no notes are missing. To ensure all payments for self-payers are collected on the same day as their clinic visit wherever possible. To type letters and other correspondence accurately and swiftly. To ensure a log of any payments received is completed on a weekly basis and updated on the appropriate management systems. To provide clinic receptionist duties if required to do so. To maintain inventory of supplies. To collaborate closely with medical staff, department heads, and other administrators to support effective communication, collaboration, and problem-solving. To undertake mandatory training relevant to the role to remain compliant with our ways of working. Any other duties that may be required consistent with the nature and grade of the post.

title: Ward Clerk - Stroke Unit
company: University Hospitals Dorset NHS Foundation Trust
advertiser_name: University Hospitals Dorset NHS Foundation Trust
description: We are looking for a Ward Clerk to join our team here on the Stroke Unit, to work with our staff to support the day to day running of an dynamic ward, liaise with various teams throughout the Trust, facilitate safe discharges from hospital and help communicate with patients, their friends, and family. The successful applicant will enjoy working in a busy fast paced environment, will work closely with members of the multidisciplinary team to maintain smooth running of the ward service and care. They must have excellent communication skills, have a putting patients first approach to work, be able to prioritise, organise, be highly motivated; possess a calm approach to the working day and have a good sense of humour. They will also need to be able to keep clear records in line with information governance. You will be required to work Saturdays, Sundays and Mondays, covering the seven days a week service with our current Ward Clerks.
